summary: Audit of a 31-turn conversation. The agent pulled the account but proceeded to check subscription status without completing full verification required for subscription/order issues, and did not offer an escalation route after the customer reported a problem with their subscription. No personal/payment data or promises policy violations were found, and agent conduct was acceptable.

findings.quote: I see, well I can definitely check on your account status while we're here
findings.explanation: For subscription or order status issues the policy requires full verification (full name, account ID and order ID). Although the account was pulled up (system turn 9: 'Account has been pulled up for Domingo Rodriguez'), the agent proceeded to check status without asking for the required account ID and order ID.

findings.quote: I see, well I can definitely check on your account status while we're here
findings.explanation: The customer stated they had a problem with their subscription (turn 3). The agent acknowledged and offered to check the account but did not offer the escalation route (supervisor/complaint form/internal team) as required when a customer makes a complaint.

findings.quote: Very good. Thanks for contacting us, Mr. Domingo
findings.explanation: The agent closed the conversation without offering an escalation route or explicitly confirming how the customer could escalate the complaint if unresolved.
